## Affected callers
- `WorkspaceQueryScope::new` creates a root context, then enters it and registers the snapshot analyzer (`crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:2672`, `crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:2684`); `root` now supplies a fresh retained-domain cell (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:872`).
- `AnalyzerQueryScope::new` constructs a default context (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3328`); default contexts now clone the active context's retained-domain cell (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:900`).
- `replayable_query_cache_cell` opens a retained scope inside its build wave before capturing the receipt (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:204`); that scope uses the shared domain selected by `for_retained_fill` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3311`).
- `NativePointBatch` opens a retained scope before capturing resolution reads (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/native_points.rs:351`); its nested `replayable_query_cache_fill` also opens one (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:407`), reaching the same domain initializer (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3314`).
- `IcfgProviderBehaviorIdentity::workspace` seeds its full and read digests with the two changed constants (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:200`, `crates/bifrost-semantic/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:208`, `crates/bifrost-semantic/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:252`).

## Paths
- `ReadAttribution::capture` retains request state and `install` restores it on the executing thread (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3160`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3170`); default context construction obtains the retained-domain cell from that current request state (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:900`).
- `inherit_query_incompleteness` compares child and parent domain IDs before propagating completion state (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:1495`); retained scope construction assigns the domain before `with_context` registers the context (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3311`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3297`).
- JVM `derived_read` opens a retained scope on a cache build, then calls `replayable_query_cache_value` (`crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/jvm/hierarchy.rs:161`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/jvm/hierarchy.rs:166`); that helper and its nested fill each open another retained scope (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:449`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:407`), all passing through the shared initializer (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3314`).
- Scope destruction restores attribution and calls `end_query` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3464`); domain destruction separately retires its ID from registered analyzer caches (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:787`). The new context cell holds an additional domain owner after an individual fill exits (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:829`).

## Value flow
- The context's retained-domain cell owns an `Arc<RequestCacheDomain>` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:829`); domain registration stores deduplicated weak references to analyzer caches, and retirement removes their domain entries (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:769`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3507`).
- `for_retained_fill` assigns an atomic ID once per initialized cell (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3314`); `prepare_request_cache_domain` uses that ID as the analyzer's cache-map key, and cache guards select the corresponding entry (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:16022`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3431`).
- The selected domain supplies `definition_units` to SQL definition lookup and `parent_units` to parent lookup (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:13544`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:10875`); the domain owner assigned at `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3311` therefore selects both memos.
- The `Some` domain assigned by retained scope construction (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:3311`) also makes `query_file_state_snapshot` return `None` before consulting the analyzer snapshot (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:8355`).
- The changed ICFG constants seed digests that both receive engine inputs, while only the full digest receives workspace content identity (`crates/bifrost-semantic/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:208`, `crates/bifrost-semantic/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:252`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:267`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:279`); `class_set_behavior` derives summary keys from both halves (`crates/bifrost-flow/src/type_flow/summary.rs:6379`).
- The added two-fill test reads parent and definition memos (`crates/bifrost-tools/src/engine_tests/retained_source_queries.rs:863`); parent lookup records `DefinitionParents` before checking its memo, and definition lookup records the complete answer digest after obtaining definitions (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:10868`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:17514`). Receipt capture stores read keys and replay forwards them to current contexts (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:283`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:262`).
